newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian, Ukranian boosters to lift ICO satellites.
newsitem.headline: Russian, Ukranian boosters to lift ICO satellites.

text.p: ICO Global Communications said on Monday it had chosen Russian and Ukrainian-made rockets to launch its communication satellites.
A company statement said that Russian Proton and Ukrainian Zenith boosters would be used for six launches over 20 months starting from 1998.
Another six ICO satellites will be launched by U.S.-made Atlas ILAS and Delta III rockets, it said.
Last year Britain-based ICO ordered U.S. Hughes Space and Communication Inc. to produce 12 satellites to set up a global communication network.

The statement said the Proton rockets would be launched from the Baikonur cosmodromme in Kazakhstan and the Zenith rockets would blast off from a special platform in the Pacific ocean by the Sea Launch company.
Both rockets must lift satellites into a 10,355-km (6,431-mile) orbit to provide telephone communications around the world.
